title: Evolved Ideas
description: IDEATE-stage artifact. Output of idea-evolver. A set of research ideas produced by mutating or recombining top-ranked ideas from an idea_tournament. Every evolved idea carries parent_ids (minItems:1) — the non-empty provenance chain is the structural anti-slop guard ('where did this come from'). A fabricated or provenance-free idea is schema-rejected. evidence_ref links back to the tournament or hypothesis source.

ideas.description: Evolved ideas, each derived from one or more parent ideas via mutation, recombination, or strengthening. minItems:1 ensures a non-empty evolution.

idea_id.description: Unique identifier for this evolved idea, e.g. EV-001

summary.description: One-sentence description of the evolved idea (non-blank)

parent_ids.description: Anti-slop provenance: the idea_id(s) this evolved idea was mutated or recombined from. At least one required — an idea with no parents is schema-rejected ('where did this come from').

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: references to the tournament artifact, hypothesis_ids, or gap_ids backing this evolved idea. At least one required; each must be non-blank.

mutation_type.description: Optional: the transformation applied to the parent idea(s).
